linux.post_install:
unpack() { if unzip -tq "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq "$1"; else tar -xf "$1"; fi rm -f "$1" } github_asset() { curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$1/releases/latest" | python3 -c ' import json, sys wanted = sys.argv[1] for asset in json.load(sys.stdin)["assets"]: if wanted in asset["name"]: print(asset["browser_download_url"]) break ' "$2" } url="$(github_asset IronOak-Studios/BrainBread "linuxserver.tar.gz")" curl -fL --retry 3 -o gse-download "$url" unpack gse-download
# steamclient.so for the Steam API (LinuxGSM fix_steamcmd.sh does the same). for bits in 64 32; do lib="$(find . "$HOME/.steam" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" -maxdepth 4 -path "*linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)" if [ -z "$lib" ]; then lib="$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -path "*steamcmd/linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)"; fi if [ -n "$lib" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits" ln -sf "$(readlink -f "$lib")" "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits/steamclient.so" fi done
